description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—across a range of popularity values. The x-axis, labeled "Question Popularity," spans from 5 to 25, with data points plotted at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Values," ranges from 0.55 to 1.00, representing the measured performance metrics. The "Accuracy" metric, shown as a blue line with circular markers, starts at approximately 0.65 at a popularity of 5, rises to a peak of about 0.82 at a popularity of 12, and then declines to around 0.81 at a popularity of 25. The "Confidence" metric, represented by a green line with triangular markers, begins at approximately 0.94 at a popularity of 5, increases to a peak of about 0.97 at a popularity of 10, and then gradually decreases to around 0.97 at a popularity of 25. The "Alignment" metric, depicted as a red line with square markers, starts at approximately 0.75 at a popularity of 5, increases to a peak of about 0.87 at a popularity of 12, and then decreases to around 0.85 at a popularity of 25. The plot shows that all three metrics generally increase with question popularity, with "Confidence" consistently having the highest values, followed by "Alignment," and then "Accuracy."
